about: Frankendom parts, stage 1 (Dom 2026-10-28: 'you become what you kill'). Cutting a fallen boss (tap, as before; no Take button) adds that part to the player's inventory automatically: the corpse:cut event names the boss's data/profiles.json id and the unit; the part is `<profile id>:<slot id>`. A part keeps the HIGHEST star level it was ever cut at (data/stars.json levels: 0, 1, 2), which is its rarity (`rarities`) and, for star 1 and 2, its trophy tag (the star level's trophy name). `slots`: the places on the hero; `units` are the physics cut units that fill them (head, arm_left, arm_right, leg_left, leg_right, torso_waist); the weapon slot has none (it shows the boss-weapon reward of data/progression.json and is not equipped here). One equipped part per slot; equip and unequip are one tap each. The inventory and the equipped map ride in the data/progression.json save as optional fields (`parts`, `equipped`), so a save from before them loads with both empty. `maxCount`: the cap on how many times one part is counted. Stage 1 is the inventory and the menu only: nothing is drawn on the hero yet (stage 2). `button` / `panel`: the ☰ button and the sheet it opens (DOM only, pointer-events on the button and sheet, the palette is the V1 journal's). `text`: every word the menu shows. Values are checked by src/parts.ts validateParts at load; keys by src/sim/validate.js.

fit.about: Stage 2 fit rules (src/fight/parts-fit.ts, ported from OpenTrident's MIT parts-fit.js; the per-body rows are data/parts-fit-rows.json). `limits`: the clamps on the stretch of a donor bone to the hero's (boneLo..boneHi) and on the hips-to-head height ratio used for thickness (heightLo..heightHi); a leg outside them leaves a lift (liftRow). `limits.coverFrac` / `limits.meanK` (OpenTrident PR #12 collar rule): when the donor's own cut ring is at least coverFrac x the hero's ring at the same plane the donor covers the hole itself and gets NO collar, else a collar at the mean of the two radii x meanK in the donor's texel. `seam`: how a cut ring is measured (src/fight/parts-fit.ts seamRing): the vertices within `bandM` metres of the cut plane (at least `minVerts` of them), radius = that `percentile` of their distance from the axis, texel = the `uvPercentile` of their uvs. `eps`: lengths in metres below which a bone or a hips-to-head distance counts as zero. `bones`: the two joints the height ratio is read between. `lift`: the unit that moves the feet and the two measure keys summed to a leg length. `skin`: three.js skin attributes carry `influences` bone slots per vertex; a uv has `uvStride` numbers. `collar`: a short open tube over each cut seam, `segments` round, rows rounded to 1/`roundScale` m; `joints` = where (bone, `at` fraction of the bone's length to its first child) and which `rule` sizes it; `rules`: radius = rK x the measure `rOf`, height = max(hMin, hK x the measure `hOf`); `fallback`: a measure the body row lacks = k x `of` (or just k, in metres, when no `of`).

wear.about: Stage 2 wear (Dom 2026-10-30: 'you become what you kill'; src/parts-wear.ts the rules, src/fight/parts-wear.ts the scene work). An equipped part VISIBLY replaces the matching piece of the hero (look only, no stat changes). ON by default; `flags.off` is the kill-switch (?parts=off wears nothing and fetches no donor) and `flags.force` is the stills way to wear a loadout without playing (?wear=pitborn:arm_left,castle-guard:leg_left: `profile:slot` ids, wearable donors only, bypasses the save). `mesh`: the name prefixes of the cut GLB contract (docs/CUT-CONTRACT.md): a unit's pieces are `piece_<unit>` and, for a unit cut in two (the Minotaur's head), `piece_<unit>_*`; the donor's own `cap_*` stump meshes are never worn (OpenTrident psyche-seam-fix: a worn donor part carries no cap, its end sits inside the hero). `units`: per cut unit that can be worn (a unit with no row, the torso, is not wearable yet and its Equip button is not offered): `collar` = the data/parts.json fit.collar.joints id of the seam the donor part meets the hero at, `lift` = the fit.lift.unit key liftRow reads for this unit (absent = no lift). `heroHost`: the hero's permanent collar rows (data/parts-fit-rows.json, the hero row) are drawn in the skin of this hero piece. `budget`: `skinnedDrawsMax` = the most skinned draws the worn hero may have (OpenTrident's cap for a loaded group is 8; the cut hero alone already draws more, see test/parts-wear.test.mjs), `partsMax` = the most parts worn at once.
